newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Van Lanschot hidden reserves at Dfl 110 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Van Lanschot hidden reserves at Dfl 110 mln.

text.p: Dutch bank F.van Lanschot Bankiers said on Wednesday it had hidden reserves of 110 million guilders at the end of 1996.
Van Lanschot was revealing for the first time its provision for general contingencies, designated by the Dutch acronym VAR.
Dutch banks have been ordered to unveil their VARs by the year 2000 to comply with European Union rules.

From 1997, some of the reserves will be transferred to a new open fund for general risks (FAR), while some will be added to shareholders equity, Van Lanschot said. It gave no breakdown of the proportions to go to each. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
